incident.description: A bad-H new-three-transfer diagnostic replay ran from the KLAPS50 root instead of its isolated run cwd.
incident.observed_window_utc: 2026-10-22 12:12–12:18 UTC (as reported by root; inventory recorded at 12:20:06Z).
incident.preservation: All 33 current raw files were archived as hardlinks and then atomically moved to quarantined_names; post-quarantine review verified hashes/inodes and found no root-level raw names.
incident.scientific_disposition: Exclude the bad-cwd diagnostic and all its outputs from scientific interpretation. This is a working-directory incident, not evidence of a source or physics failure.

replace_semantics_correction.supersedes: The initial review treated prior same-name state for three status=replace files as unresolved and warned a prior inode might have been truncated.
replace_semantics_correction.result: The pinned Intel/OpenMP/big-endian probe reproduced the relevant OPEN modes and retained the inode on replacement. The three current status=replace output inodes were born during the incident window, so the run did not overwrite or truncate a pre-existing inode at those paths.
replace_semantics_correction.recorded_launch_history: The recorded bad-launch sequence contains no rm/unlink. With the exact-profile probe showing status=replace retains an existing inode, the three incident-born output inodes establish that this launch created those files without truncating a prior inode.

protected_state.c2_isolated_working_directories: Root verified the isolated C2 run working directories were unchanged.

separate_clean_guarded_receipts.scope: Separate guarded C1 T1 diagnostic replays, not results from the bad-cwd incident and not C2 model reads/forecasts.

evidence_inventory.replace_probe: Pinned source and result metadata only; probe executables and raw files are excluded.

openmp_big_endian_probe.scope: Same replacement OPEN modes under pinned Intel runtime, OpenMP, and big-endian conversion; test artifacts only.

compiler_profile.reported_flags: pinned REPRO flags including -O2 -fp-model strict -fimf-arch-consistency=true -no-ftz -fpe0, plus -convert big_endian -qopenmp
